request.subject: UNIT:UNDEAD:CAPTAIN

layers.text: Add only bone ornaments: one small pale warm ivory skull on each shoulder of the black robe, and a row of three small pale ivory bone spikes along the top ridge of the black hood. Keep everything else exactly the same: the black hood and robe with the violet trim, the violet eyes, flames and sparks, the white beard, the skull staff, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
